purpose: Profile the balanced 32x32 QoS 1 shape to explain its higher p50/p99 than Mosquitto.

capture.host_load_note: The shared host also ran unrelated jobs; absolute latency is not a clean benchmark, but the 425-sample symbol ranking is zero-loss and consistent with the serial QoS 2 profile.

conclusions: The delivery flush path is the dominant protocol cost: flushSlotLockedMode is 20.36% self and 44.48% children.
Lock contention is visible: sync.Futex.wait is 7.60% self, and flushSlotLockedMode takes the global state lock once per queued delivery.
Network encoding/writing is the next layer: writePublish is 5.64% self and 18.52% children, with writeAllSlices at 12.78% children.

The next candidate is batching transient queue pops under one state-lock critical section (for example up to eight deliveries), then writing outside the lock. It must preserve durable session-packet priority, queue order, inflight-limit checks and push-back rollback.
AnyTask.yield at 6.54% and the runtime loop remain a separate scheduling cost.
